newsitem.title: USA: CSCE to raise margins on spot Dec coffee futures.
newsitem.headline: CSCE to raise margins on spot Dec coffee futures.

text.p: The Coffee, Sugar and Cocoa Exchange said Monday it would raise margins on the December 1996 "C" coffee contract by $1,000 to $3,750, effective October 29.
The margin on all other coffee contracts will remain $1,750, the exchange said in a statement.
The change comes just two weeks after the exchange raised the spot margin by $500.

In addition, CSCE said that as of October 29 it will increase trade margins on all straddle and arbitrage transactions involving the December 1996 contract by $1,000 to $2,700. Margins on all other straddle and arbitrage transactions of "C" coffee futures will remain $700.
For customers who are not exchange members or members of the trade, margins will be 140 percent above the trade rates, CSCE said.
